high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from a user named Jenni (@hashjenni). The tweet discusses the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in detecting breast cancer five years before it develops. The tweet includes two mammogram images side by side, with red squares highlighting specific areas in each image. The left mammogram shows a breast with a noticeable area highlighted in red, indicating a potential anomaly. The right mammogram also has a red square highlighting another area, suggesting a comparison or progression over time.
